name: Get-ComputerInfo
title: Inspect Windows System Information
summary: Displays operating system, hardware, firmware, and Windows configuration details.

examples.command: Get-ComputerInfo | Select-Object WindowsProductName, WindowsVersion, OsArchitecture, CsManufacturer, CsModel
examples.description: Shows a concise system identity summary without changing the computer.

permissions.notes: Most identification fields are available in a standard PowerShell session.

risk.warning: Output can contain device and organization details; review it before sharing.

common_errors.meaning: Use Windows PowerShell 5.1 or a compatible PowerShell environment.
